decisions.reason: The source changes only the permissible power-connector pin order and matching-board constraint; it does not change I2C cable length, speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
Reordering pins does not change the selected connector series, availability, cost tolerance, or component-sourceability policy.
The source concerns the power-to-main connector pin order, not the battery connector's physical placement, orientation, clearance, or spacing.
Although the client permits a pin order that suits the layout, the source does not modify any existing board dimensions, mounting, enclosure-fit, connector-form, or layer-count requirement.
The source addresses the separate power-to-main connector; it does not change the battery connector series, pitch, pin count, pin functions, or mounting type.
The physical order of pins on the interboard power connector does not change the switched 5V rail's voltage, enable control, converter, pull-down, loads, or operating pattern.
The connector pin-order decision does not alter the task-local requirement to review assembly settings, pricing, or component availability.
